trigger.description: Operator enabled lexical RAM-tier warmload on a host where ee can safely retain lexical index bytes in process heap memory. This is the supported V1 RAM-tier posture and deliberately does not claim OS-level mmap/mlock pinning under the crate-level unsafe-code ban.

expected_emission.repair_string: Use the heap warmload path as the supported V1 optimization. Do not require OS-level pinning unless a future product decision explicitly re-scopes the feature and lands audited proof.
